Saree.title: Saree
Saree.description: Represents a handwoven silk or handloom saree in the Swapari Saree catalog, including persisted customer reviews.

id.description: Unique identifier for the saree document.

name.description: Display title of the saree (e.g., Pure Katan Silk Banarasi).

image_url.description: 2:3 vertical aspect ratio product photograph URL, path, or compressed data URI.

in_stock.description: Real-time availability status for WhatsApp checkout.

category.description: Handloom weave category (e.g., Maheshwari, Paithani, Narayanpeth, Kanjivaram, Mysore silk, Gadwal, Banarasi).

reviews.description: Bounded list (max 50) of customer star ratings and text comments persisted on the saree document.

is_deleted.description: Flag indicating whether the admin has removed this saree from the public storefront across all devices.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized store administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

StoreConfig.title: StoreConfig
StoreConfig.description: Global store settings including the active WhatsApp order receiving phone number.

id.description: Unique identifier for the store configuration document (e.g., store_config).

whatsapp_number.description: 10-15 digit WhatsApp business order receiving phone number without plus prefix (e.g. 919168612319).

google_verification_code.description: Google Search Console HTML tag verification token for <meta name='google-site-verification'>.

custom_categories.description: Bounded list (max 30) of custom saree weave categories added by the administrator.

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp of last configuration update.

/sarees/{sareeId}.description: Catalog collection storing all Swapari Saree products, real-time stock status, and customer reviews.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Collection of verified store administrators authorized to mutate inventory.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Global store settings collection used for real-time synchronization across devices.
